originality.rationale: The closest 2018 first-order Reed–Muller paper establishes four-request batch recovery, not six; the January 2026 all-symbol framework proves a dual-distance bound, treats simplex/MDS families, and explicitly leaves Reed–Muller examples open. Six repeated requests are insufficient to imply six arbitrary mixed requests. The 2025 majority-logic decoder addresses message coefficients rather than six stored-coordinate requests. Search and prior record comparisons found no covering result. An unindexed equivalent 1970s orthogonal-check formulation remains a residual risk.
residual_risks: The 1975 Rahman–Blake article was relevant but its full text was inaccessible; an overlooked stronger historical six-demand theorem could affect originality.
No searchable index proves absence of unindexed equivalent results.
This result is specific to sixteen coordinates; an even-dimension extrapolation is unproved.
